Good morning! Doing my Saturday morning session 📈

After finishing my backtesting and doing the usual reflection,
I was staring at charts the whole time.

What you often hear is that
there are all sorts of settings like indicators and MAs, but the one thing everyone ends up looking at in common is the candlestick…

I looked into it 👀

If the time basis differs between overseas and domestic, the candlestick shape also changes
For example, on Exness you can check "the value at a certain time" at the close of the 4-hour candle, whereas at Hirose Tsusho the candle is still forming and isn't confirmed until 3 hours later
Even if it surges, if it fully retraces, you get a large so-called power bar on one side and a big upper wick on the other

So what should I look at and trust?

That probably
depends on each trader…

By the way, this article
is written by a guy who has lost every trade this month…

Anyway! Let's do our best next week too 💪
Thanks for your hard work this week, fellow traders ✨

【Overseas FX Deposit/Withdrawal Issue】
The first responses from each company have arrived.

This time #XMTrading #XS #VantageTrading #TitanFX #Ultima responded.

All of the brokers' responses came not from the Japan staff but from head-office executive level.

To state the result as of now, all brokers gave the same answer: the view is that bank deposits and withdrawals are unlikely to all disappear suddenly from December.

Of course, card deposits will also continue to be usable.

Each company is meeting closely with its payment agents too, and has already secured multiple deposit/withdrawal lines by connecting with several companies rather than a single exclusive one.

However, I can't deny that deposits/withdrawals may become slightly more complicated.

They also said they will respond flexibly to unforeseen circumstances and will be more conscious than ever about users' deposits and withdrawals. (Of course, withdrawal suspensions for terms violations are a separate matter; this time it's about responding to the amended law.)

Some brokers have already acquired a Japanese securities company, but unless the broker launches it, I can't say; I'll just add at the end that all brokers are doing quite a lot of preparation.

We will receive reports whenever there is progress.

H〇M and EX〇〇〇S ended their partnership earlier, so I didn't ask them this time, but from now on I will check with them too in order to compile the information!
